name: study-skills
title_zh: 读过的书会自己长成第二大脑的阅读插件
tagline_zh: 不满足于划线高亮？它把分析阅读、卡片笔记、信念纠错串成一条流水线，读完一本书，笔记自动连成网。
tagline_en: Tired of just highlighting? It turns analytical reading, Zettelkasten notes, and belief-checking into one.
desc_en: A Claude Code plugin for durable agent learning: analytical reading, a cross-linked Zettelkasten slip-box with a bundled CLI, first-person beliefs with falsifiers, experience capture, and deliberation forks.
why_zh: 不是笔记工具，是学习操作系统：每本书都拆成可验证的信念和反例，卡片自动交叉引用。
why_en: Not a note app but a learning OS: every book becomes testable beliefs with falsifiers, cards cross-link themselves, and even.
limit_zh: 只覆盖阅读→笔记→信念检验的闭环，不做任务管理或复习提醒；需要你主动运行 CLI 命令，且卡片链接依赖你遵循既定格式。
limit_en: Only covers reading-to-notes-to-belief-checking loop; no task management or review reminders. Requires manual CLI runs and strict card format.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Reading plugin that grows a second brain from books
